biggest_catch: This is a short, time-boxed promotion: your friend must join and open a checking account between 9/1/2026 and 10/31/2026, in a Maps branch, with the Refer a Friend flyer in hand. No flyer at account opening means no $50 for you.
catches: Referrer must be a Maps Credit Union member 18+ with a Member Rewards account in good standing.
Friend must be 18+, eligible for Maps membership, and bring the Refer a Friend flyer/social post/email to a Maps branch at account opening — offers are good in branch only.
Friend must open a membership (minimum $25 deposit) plus a checking account during 9/1/2026 – 10/31/2026.
Referrer cap: $50 per friend, up to 10 referrals ($500 total).
Reward bonuses deposited into the applicable Member Rewards account by the end of the month following the month the membership and checking account are opened.
Promotion subject to cease at any time; cannot be combined with any other monetary incentive offer.
No 1099/tax statement on the fetched page; standard referral bonuses may be reportable.

Your friend (18+, eligible for Maps membership) brings the flyer to any Maps branch between 9/1/2026 and 10/31/2026.
